items.reason: Clicking 7D then 1H while both requests were pending left a consistent final state (1H active, 1h data, no stuck loading); when the 7d response was artificially delayed to land 6 s after the 1h response with latency values marked x100, the stale data never rendered, so out-of-order responses are discarded.

The primary action is non-optimistic (the active range button and data only flip after the response arrives), but the 'Updated <time>' header advances even when the refresh fails: with getMetrics patched to always reject, both polls rejected yet the header still advanced, claiming a fresh update the server never confirmed, only partly offset by the stale-data banner.
